scope: Tenant-scoped PostgreSQL full-text search across saved content, campaigns and asset metadata, with exact result opening and existing unsaved-change confirmation.

localExecution.apiBuild: Passed in prior run of unchanged API source; final focused run reused those compiled API bytes.

attempts.cause: Delayed-response test unregistered a route before its async handler completed; route.fulfill raised Route is already handled. Await handler completion before unroute.
Importing a decorated Nest controller through tsx without decorator metadata failed. Query/schema extracted to a pure module; final two unit tests pass.
Harness assumed a real .env existed. Environment is actually absent; hash guard now compares optional presence without creating it. No fixture started in that attempt.
Search error locator also matched the Next.js route announcer alert. Scoped the assertion to the expected search error while retaining request-error/retry checks.
Root/docs status links differed after relative-link adjustment. Synced both status copies byte-for-byte with a common repository link before packaging.

review.finding: Delayed initial content selection could replace a newer draft and clear dirty state.
review.resolution: Shared selection generation invalidates delayed responses on new draft, open, back and view changes; browser regression holds the old response during new draft editing.

limitations: Search covers content, campaigns and asset names/tags only. Other global domains, nested workspaces, autosave/conflict resolution and broader UX acceptance remain open.

Whole-word simple-dictionary matching, all words required; no fuzzy search, stemming, semantic search or large-tenant load acceptance claimed. Content uses existing FTS expression/index; campaigns/assets use existing tenant indexes. Offset <=1000 and page <=50 bound result retrieval, not total database scan cost.

Local HTTP/browser checks use independent generated PostgreSQL/Redis fixture containers and random loopback ports. Existing user services/ports/volumes were not fixtures. Asset rows are metadata-only; no object decode/worker/live-provider acceptance is claimed locally.
Full exact-source unit/HTTP/browser/readability/native-upgrade/24-phase Compose checks require all three published CI jobs. CI verifies fixtures and does not deploy.
RECOVERY-01P local/CI fixture work is closed. Production durable backup/retention/RPO-RTO and deployed real-provider restore remain separate open gates.
